title: pavonia parva
intro: Pavonia parva, commonly known as Small Rosemallow, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the mallow family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia due to its calming effects. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and sedative, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents in Pavonia parva are also believed to exhibit antimicrobial and antipyretic properties, making it a promising candidate for further research into its medicinal applications.
